knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Scrubbed staff stand close to the field, and laminar flow makes that closeness more important. The other options are not reasons in the source.
Snug shoes with waterproof soles, or galoshes, are the better option. The other options are open or unsuitable for splash protection.
The mask comes off before the person exits, and it is never left hanging at the neck. The other options are not safe practice.

practicalCriteria: Given a case plan that requires double gloving, the learner double gloves and checks the fit and damage of each glove before the case.
After a simulated case, the learner takes off the mask and cap before walking out and fits a fresh white jacket for the public corridor.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of gloving and dress-out
Checklist entry for the protective items checked
stopWorkCriteria: A glove splits or a mask gets wet mid-case: stop the task and swap the item straight away.
A visitor enters without changing into theatre clothing: stop the entry and direct them to change.
